description: Defines the ThermalImpl class implementing thermal management functions, including temperature thresholds, clock speed control, and temperature readings, for a hardware platform.

classes.name: ThermalImpl
classes.description: Implements thermal management interface, including temperature thresholds, clock speed adjustments, and temperature readings.

methods.name: conv
methods.description: Converts between PWRMgr_ThermalState_t and ThermalTemperature enum values.

methods.name: GetTemperatureThresholds
methods.description: Retrieves high and critical temperature thresholds from hardware.

methods.name: SetTemperatureThresholds
methods.description: Sets high and critical temperature thresholds in hardware.

methods.name: GetClockSpeed
methods.description: Reads current CPU clock speed from system file.

methods.name: SetClockSpeed
methods.description: Sets CPU clock speed via system files.

methods.name: DetemineClockSpeeds
methods.description: Determines available CPU clock speeds and assigns normal, scaled, and minimal speeds.

methods.name: GetTemperature
methods.description: Reads current temperature and WiFi temperature from hardware sensors.
